card: This PR replaces the Boost.Test library with a lightweight in-tree C++ unit test runner and assertion framework in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}. Replacing Boost.Test simplifies depends and Guix dependencies, improves clang-tidy and IWYU compatibility, and enables richer assertion failure messages via expression decomposition. Removing Boost's test framework resolves long-standing discussions tracked in #8670 and #34666. Backward-compatible BOOST_* macro aliases are retained so existing tests and in-flight pull requests do not experience merge conflicts. Over 160 of the 167 touched files are mechanical include changes generated by a scripted diff.
changed_since_previous: The underlying approach and commit structure remain identical to the previous description; commits were rebased with minor adjustments.

enables: Future migration of individual test files from BOOST_* shims to native TEST_CASE and CHECK macros.

evidence: Long-standing interest in eliminating Boost.Test tracked in open issue #34666 ('[rfc] Replacing Boost Unit Test Framework?') and historical issue #8670 ('Replacing Boost Test Framework').
PR description notes concrete maintenance pain points: 'Replacing Boost.Test as a runner helps us simplify depends and guix as well as use IWYU and clang-tidy within the tests more effectively.'

Author cites workarounds for Boost.Test issues fixed in #36045 ('test: avoid undersized Boost.Test signal stacks') and underflow/overflow comparisons addressed by using std::cmp_* for mixed-sign integers.
problem: Boost.Test brings external dependency maintenance costs in depends and Guix, impedes static analysis tools like IWYU and clang-tidy, and suffers from quirks like platform-specific signal stack issues and unintuitive assertion macros that often omit operand values when reporting failures.

risk.why: A flaw in the test runner or assertion decomposition logic could cause test cases to falsely succeed or spuriously fail, risking masked regressions in CI.

scope_notes: Out of 167 touched files, approximately 160 are modified via a mechanical scripted-diff that updates include paths from <boost/test/unit_test.hpp> to <test/util/framework.h>. Review should focus on the new framework implementation in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}, src/test/main.cpp, and the build-system removals in depends, Guix, and CMake.
summary: Replaces the Boost.Test library with a custom in-tree C++ test runner and assertion framework implemented in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}. The new framework uses expression decomposition to log operands and values on assertion failure, while providing backward-compatible BOOST_* macro shims to avoid breaking existing tests or conflicting with in-flight PRs. Boost.Test is removed from depends, Guix, vcpkg, and CMake build configurations.
